notes: «- هو الطحان -» is an editor gloss between dashes and is left out
The bare «عن خالد» is kept apart from «خالد بن عبد الله» (rule 9): the text does not say they are the same man
«أن رجلا، من الأنصار بمعناه» is an unnamed Companion (rule 8); the words after «وقال - يعني النبي -» are his report of the Prophet
